◆ register_handler()

uint32_t beerocks::net::NetlinkEventListener::register_handler ( const NetlinkEventHandler &  handler)
inline

Sets the Netlink event handler function.

The handler function will be called back whenever a Netlink event occurs. It must parse the Netlink message passed in as parameter to obtain the data it is interested in.

Parameters
handlerNetlink event handler function.
Returns
Handler unique identifier (required to remove handler later, when not needed any more).

std::unordered_map<uint32_t, NetlinkEventHandler> beerocks::net::NetlinkEventListener::m_handlers

Map containing the Netlink event handler functions that are called back whenever a Netlink event occurs. The map key is the handler unique identifier and the value is the handler function.
